# Betting Calculator Project Setup

## Project Overview
A modern, interactive web-based betting calculator application built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3. Features odds conversion, implied probability calculation, and bet payouts.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend:** HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript
- **Deployment:** Browser-based (no server required)
- **Compatibility:** All modern browsers

## Features
✅ Odds Converter (Decimal, Fractional, Moneyline)
✅ Implied Probability Calculator
✅ Bet Payout Calculator
✅ Responsive Design
✅ Real-time Calculations
✅ No Dependencies Required

## How to Run

1. **Open in Browser:**
   - Double-click `index.html` or drag it into your browser
   - Or right-click `index.html` → "Open with" → Choose your browser

2. **Using VS Code Live Server (Optional):**
   - Install "Live Server" extension in VS Code
   - Right-click `index.html`
   - Select "Open with Live Server"
   - Browser will automatically refresh on file changes

3. **Using Python (Optional):**
   - Open terminal in project directory
   - Run: `python -m http.server 8000`
   - Open: `http://localhost:8000`

betting-calculator/

## Features Documentation

### Odds Converter
- Converts between Decimal, Fractional, and Moneyline formats
- Real-time conversion on input
- Supports all common odds formats used globally

### Implied Probability Calculator
- Calculates winning probability from odds
- Visual probability bar for quick reference
- Displays both winning and losing probabilities

### Bet Calculator
- Calculate total payout for any bet
- Shows potential profit/loss
- Works with any decimal odds value

## Development

No build process required! This is a static application:
- Open `index.html` directly in any modern browser
- Edit files in VS Code or any text editor
- Changes reflect immediately on page refresh

## Browser Support

- Chrome 90+
- Firefox 88+
- Safari 14+
- Edge 90+
- Mobile browsers (iOS Safari, Chrome Mobile)

## No External Dependencies

All functionality is built with vanilla JavaScript - no jQuery, React, or other libraries required!

## Tips

- Use the dropdown to select your input odds format
- Calculations update automatically as you type
- Click "Clear All" to reset all fields
- Bookmark for quick access to your betting calculator
